On Memorial Day, we honor the brave men and women who put their lives on the line to protect our nation. We commemorate their tremendous courage and commit ourselves to carrying their legacy.

To every hero who has made the ultimate sacrifice, thank you for your service.

It’s Memorial Day weekend! You’ve got places to be and things to see. The last thing you need is orange barrels holding you up.
We’ve got you!
We’re lifting barrels and freeing up roads this Memorial Day weekend so your drive is as smooth and relaxing as your long weekend ☀️

Gold Star families endure an unimaginable pain losing a loved one that made the ultimate sacrifice.  We hold a sacred duty to stand by them. We must continue to honor the legacy of those we’ve lost and support the families that carry their light.

Women’s health isn’t just about protecting one aspect of our anatomy.

Heart health, domestic violence, informed care, and so much more impact our health.

Thank you to the volunteers that planted over 10,000 flowers on the Capitol lawn yesterday!

When we roll our sleeves and work together, there's nothing we can't do 🌸

Support for new moms and babies can’t begin and end at delivery. Here in Michigan, we’re providing extra support through Healthy Moms, Healthy Babies, community health programs, and expanded doula services to keep moms and babies healthy before, during, and after delivery.

Video

Strong literacy skills are the foundation that help kids make sense of the world, from solving everyday problems to imagining bold ideas. Across the country, students are struggling with reading. Michigan is no exception. 
But together, we're making meaningful progress.

Every Child Reads brings all of this together with a simple focus:

✏️ Start early

✏️ Use proven practices

✏️ Make sure kids get the support they need, when they need it

When we invest in these steps and in the people doing the work every day, we give every child the chance to grow into a confident reader and writer. And that’s not just good for students, it’s good for Michigan’s future.

Too many Michiganders have had to make the impossible choice of paying rent or seeing a doctor. No family deserves that.

We must do more to provide real relief from medical debt. Here’s how we do it ⬇️

Let’s come together to:

•Cap interest rates on medical debt.
•Prevent medical debt from showing up on your credit report. 
•Require hospitals to set up financial assistance programs for patients.
•And ban liens or foreclosures on homes because of medical debt.

For too many Michiganders, buying a home feels out of reach. There’s not enough housing and what is available is too expensive.

Michiganders want action to make housing more affordable and attainable. Let’s come together to cut red tape, streamline zoning, and Build, Baby Build.
